items: 【All-in-One Kids Phone Toys】Kids Toddler Detective & Spy Toys Kid's phone designed for fun and learning! With educational learning apps for promoting creativity, dual cameras for capturing every moment, exciting games and music player to keep them entertained. Exclusive features include ABC, Story, Painting, Paino etc to enhance kid's creativity and knowledge! Plus, the parent app can ensure their gaming experience is both safe and enjoyable. Gift your child a learning toys to learn and play.

【Educational Kids Toys】This kids toddler tablet toys phone newly added learning A-Z letters, fruits and anmials, each word combining letter pronunciation and associated animal sounds, which stimulate learning in a fun and engaging way. Moreover, with features like Story, Piano, Paint and math games, parents can ensure their kids are not only entertained but also expanding their knowledge and creativity. This makes our kids phone the perfect blend of play and education.

【Kids Camera & Video Recording】The 2.8" screen mini smart phone support dual cameras and video recording to capture precious memories, also the 10 adorable photo stickers will increase the fun of taking photos with friends and family, children can document their adventures and express their creativity. Equipped with an 8GB storage card, providing additional storage for photos and videos.

【It's Game Time】28 puzzle games for kids to challenge their minds and keep them entertained. From puzzles and strategy games that foster analytical thinking to creative gameplay that encourages imagination, every app is designed with educational value in mind. Plus, the anti-addiction mode allows parents to control the daily game time effectively. The durable design is perfect for little hands, featuring shockproof casing that withstands drops and spills.

【Music & Creative Tools】Kids smart phone built-in high-quality MP3 music player and story, you can pre-downlode music and storys with equipped SD card. Children can learn to play piano, or even composing their own songs! In addition, Paint provide a canvas for creative expression where kids can paint, doodle. This blend of musical and artistic opportunities makes the smartphone an excellent gifts for kids toddler, nurturing their creativity and providing a wonderful outlet for self-expression.

【Perfect Gifts for Girls Boys】Our children’s smartphone is an ideal gifts for boys and girls aged 3-10, perfect for birthday, holiday, Christmas, Easter or any special days gifts. The pocket-size mini smartphone are easy to use and carry, and the silicone case provide effective anti-fall protection. Stand out from the typical gift options and give a gift that encourages growth and fun!
